regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and ESI/CCDC footnote
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate nitro-oxoamination claim were inspected. The page states ESI availability and CCDC 993058/993059, but workspace mapping leaves SI association unestablished; no SI facts were imported and crystallographic deposits are not treated as SI.
The alkene-to-nitroalkene radical sequence is cited prior work with generic R/Y groups and is classified as a literature example, not a current-paper experiment.
The syn-B/anti-B radical model is a proposed mechanism/general pathway. Intermediates are not isolated experiments and the favored anti-B-to-(E)-C rationale carries no experiment-specific yield.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right initial 1a experiment and optimization discussion
regions.finding: The 59%/95:5 initial run, 86% NaHCO3 run, entries 3–5 loading effects, complicated no-TEMPO outcome, and 3a not-detected observation map to the six Table 1 rows on page 2 and are linked rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Scheme 1 generic structures and intermediates do not define unique machine structures.
The main-text initial run does not report workup, purification, isolated mass, or 3a detection limit.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–6, and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Six independent TEMPO/AgNO2/NaHCO3 loading experiments were retained with 0.2 mmol scale, dioxane 2 mL, 70 °C, shared 11 h or entry-2 15 h, row loadings, NMR yields/E:Z ratios, complicated no-TEMPO outcome, mesitylene basis, and 3a non-detection from the cross-page prose.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 2 entries 1–11 and footnotes a–i
regions.finding: Eleven temperature/nitrating-source conditions were retained separately. AcOH replacement, CAN identity, 1/3-equiv TEMPO/nitrating-source overrides, air atmosphere, explicit 0% or complicated outcomes, N/A selectivity, and 5%/45%/56% starting-material recoveries were structured row-wise.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 3 entries 1–5 and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Five solvent-screen experiments were retained with exact 0.2 mmol/2 mL shared scale, 60 °C, row times, NMR yields, E/Z, mesitylene basis, and 7% recovery in MeCN. Explicit 0% DMF and 3% MeCN outcomes were not converted to qualitative labels.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 4 entries 1–12 and footnotes a–i
regions.finding: Twelve aryl-allene scope rows were retained independently, including the separate 10 mmol repeat, combined versus E-only isolated yields, crude and post-isolation ratios, printed purities, and non-isolable contaminated Z isomers. Dashes remain source markers.

unresolved: Most optimization/scope rows omit atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated mass, and detection limits.
The 10 mmol Table 4 repeat does not restate absolute reagent amounts or dioxane volume.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 4 continuation prose and Figure 1
regions.finding: The prose confirms the separate 10 mmol 1a repeat (91%, 98/2) and scope interpretation. Figure 1/CCDC 993059 characterize existing (E)-2g; they are not a second preparation and do not verify the candidate SMILES.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Table 5 entries 1–5 and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Five naphthyl/heteroaryl allene experiments were retained with exact shared quantities, times, isolated E-product yields, crude E/Z ratios, and entry-2 post-isolation 98/2 ratio. Compact attachment points remain source labels where not encoded confidently.

One double nitro-oxoamination of 1q was retained with 4 equiv TEMPO/AgNO2, 3 equiv NaHCO3, dioxane, 60 °C/10 h, 65% outcome, and (E,E)/(Z,Z)=98/2. Figure 2/CCDC 993058 are characterization, not another experiment.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Table 6 entries 1–5 and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: Five alkyl-allene experiments were retained with exact 0.24 mmol substrate, 0.60 mmol AgNO2/NaHCO3, 0.20 mmol TEMPO, dioxane 2 mL, 70 °C, row times, combined or separate isolated yields, crude/post-isolation ratios, and 55%/83% Z-product purities.

unresolved: Equation 1 omits scale, solvent volume, workup, mass, and analytical bases.
Compact Table 5/6 structures remain label-only where connectivity was uncertain.
Crystallography supports source assignments but does not certify machine structure encodings.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 2 and adjacent prose
regions.finding: Three distinct downstream experiments were retained: NaBH4/silica-gel reduction to 5a (69% isolated), LiAlH4 reduction to 6a (93%), and NBA/K3PO4 addition to 7a (90%). Footnote reagents/loadings and all displayed solvents, temperatures, and times are participants/conditions.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left summary, acknowledgements, and reproduction statement
regions.finding: The summary adds no new experiment. Tao Cao's reproduction of Table 4 entries 7 and 12 and Table 5 entry 2 supplies provenance but no independent run conditions or outcomes, so no duplicate records were created.

regions.region: page 4 right column references 1–18 and crystallographic footnotes 14–15
regions.finding: Bibliography is prior-literature context. CCDC 993059 and 993058 crystal data characterize existing (E)-2g and (E,E)-2q records; they are not preparations and do not establish an SI association.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits reaction scales, solvent quantities, workups, masses, and the yield bases for 6a/7a.
Reproduction statements do not define separable runs; SI remains unassociated.
